text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her outstanding physical abilities, Maruzensky has attracted so much attention that fans start calling her Hot Rod even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Adored as a role model by the younger students, she sets her sights on the greatest of events.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky now aims to take on the Twinkle Series.
